rows: Severe thunderstorm winds blew several roofs off of outbuildings and rolled a recreational vehicle in the Study Butte/Terlingua Ranch area.
Severe thunderstorm winds broke three inch diameter tree limbs off a tree in Rio Grande Village.
Pea to golfball size hail fell in Alpine.
Nickel to golfball size hail in and around Alpine.
Several people between Texas Highway 118 and Terlingua Ranch Lodge reported penny size hail.
Big Bend National Park staff at Persimmon Gap reported penny to quarter size hail.
Penny to nickel size hail fell in Marathon.
Golfball size hail fell along U.S. Highway 67 northeast of Alpine.
Golfball sized hail fell at Terlingua High School.
Golfball to apple sized hail fell at Cottonwood Campground in Big Bend National Park.
Nickel to quarter sized hail fell south of Alpine.
Brewster County emergency manager reported baseball sized hail at Hilltop Ranch.
The hail covered the road and was about 2 inches deep.

A NWS Storm Survey concluded that damage was done to 44 power poles near Ranch Road 2627 in Brewster County, TX. Some of the poles were snapped 3 to 4 feet above the ground and all the poles fell to the south as the storm moved in the same direction around 20 mph. The poles were …
A transmission power pole was reported down along State Highway 118.

Rio Grande Electric Coop and the public reported wind damage from Lajitas, TX to Terlingua, TX. The severe winds first damaged the roof of a home and 6 power poles in Lajitas around 1700 CST. As the storm moved northeastward, it snapped 4 more power poles along State Highway 170 …
Rio Grande Electric Coop reported 2 power poles were downed near Panther Junction, TX. The severe winds also damaged a roof to a hotel/lodge near the same area.
Several windows, roofs and other structural items were damaged at the Gage Hotel in Marathon, TX.
Several windows and skylights were broken by the hail on one home. In addition, two more homes received roof and window damage. One vehicle also reported damage.
The local law enforcement reported power lines down at the border patrol checkpoint.
A thunderstorm moved over Brewster County and produced 70 mph winds three miles southeast of Study Butte.
A thunderstorm moved over Brewster County and produced golfball hail in Marathon. Windows were broken and vehicles were dented from the hail. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved over Brewster County and produced eight inches to one foot of marble to penny sized hail.
A severe thunderstorm developed in Brewster County and produced quarter sized hail in Marathon.
A severe thunderstorm developed over Brewster County and moved south of Marathon producing nickel size hail. Hail was located over highway 385 and covered the ground.
A thunderstorm moved over Brewster County and produced golfball sized hail 22 miles south southeast of Alpine. The hail covered the road.
A severe thunderstorm developed 29 miles east of Marathon and produced quarter sized hail.
A thunderstorm moved over Brewster County and produced quarter sized hail at Terlingua Ranch Lodge. The hail lasted fifteen minutes.
A thunderstorm developed over Brewster County and produced quarter sized hail in Alpine.

A thunderstorm developed over the Davis Mountains in Brewster County during the afternoon. At 3:21 pm CDT, a trained spotter positioned along Highway 90 between Marfa and Alpine witnessed the development of a funnel cloud. At 3:24 pm CDT, the funnel appeared to develop a wall clo…
A thunderstorm moved over Brewster County and produced a 63 mph wind gust about one mile southeast of Rio Grande Village as indicated by the Big Bend Portable.
A thunderstorm moved over Brewster County and produced nickel sized hail three miles west southwest of Alpine.
A thunderstorm moved over Brewster County and produced penny sized hail in Alpine.
A thunderstorm moved over Brewster County and produced golfball sized hail sixteen miles south of Marathon.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced pingpong ball sized hail in Alpine. Trees were stripped of leaves, and flower gardens were destroyed. The cost of damage is a rough estimate.

A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced an estimated 65 mph wind gust in Alpine. A tree fell on a vehicle. The size of the tree and damage to the vehicle are unknown. The cost of damage is a rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 63 mph wind gust at Panther Junction. No damage was reported.

A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced baseball sized hail on the edge of Alpine. There were car dents, damaged shingles, and broken house windows as a result of this hail. The cost of damage is a rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 59 mph wind gust in Alpine. No damage was reported.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 59 mph wind gust at the Panther Junction RAWS station.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 58 mph wind gust at the Big Bend Portable RAWS station.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced 50 to 60 mph wind gusts at the motel in Study Butte. No damage was reported.

A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced wind damage near Terlingua. Two power poles were reported to have been knocked down by wind on Highway 118 and Farm to Market Road 170. The winds were estimated to be 80+ mph. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.

A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a brief tornado northeast of Alpine. A storm chaser reported ground rotation for about two minutes ten miles north of Highway 90 on US 67. No damage was reported so the tornado was rated as an EF-0.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 64 mph wind gust at Persimmon Gap.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 62 mph wind gust near Alpine.
A thunderstorm developed across Brewster County and produced a 59 mph wind gust at the mesonet at Persimmon Gap.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a landspout just north of Alpine. There was no damage and the exact location, path width, and path length were estimated.
A thunderstorm moved through Brewster County at the northern end of Big Bend National Park and produced a wind gust of 67 mph at Persimmon Gap.

A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced wind damage in Alpine. A power pole was blown down and signs were shattered and blown down due to strong winds and hail. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
Dime to nickel sized hail was reported three miles east of Alpine.

A thunderstorm produced a landspout tornado about 15 miles northeast of Marathon. The tornado was viewed from Highway 385 from a distance of 20 miles northeast of Marathon. Review of images and radar data suggest that the landspout was located approximately 15 miles northeast of …
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced nickel sized hail and minor street flooding eight miles southeast of Alpine.
A thunderstorm produced a brief landspout about eight miles east of Marathon. The landspout dust whirl was disconnected from the storm over open land. There was no observable damage.

A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced wind damage near Marathon. At least four power poles were snapped off just above the ground along US 90. There was a transformer fire. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced wind damage in Marathon. There was structural damage with a roof off on the west side of town. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 66 mph wind gust at Persimmon Gap.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 60 mph wind gust five miles south of Marathon.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 63 mph wind gust in Castolon.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 60 mph wind gust in Castolon.

A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 64 mph wind gust at Persimmon Gap. It was a delayed report due to the cell tower being down. The Mesonet site also had 1.21 inches of rain with this storm.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 73 mph wind gust at the Castolon mesonet site. The winds gusted over 60 mph for around 10 minutes.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 63 mph wind gust at the Castolon mesonet site.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced an estimated 60 mph wind gust.

A thunderstorm produced a tornado 13 miles south southwest of Marathon. The tornado lasted approximately five minutes. It occurred on private land in an open field and no damage was reported. It was rated as an EF-U.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 65 mph wind gust at the mesonet site at Persimmon Gap.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 63 mph wind gust at the Castolon mesonet site.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 67 mph wind gust at the Castolon mesonet site.
A thunderstorm moved across Brewster County and produced a 67 mph wind gust in Castolon.
A thunderstorm produced an 80 mph wind gust at the Castolon Mesonet site.
A thunderstorm produced a 59 mph wind gust at the Mesonet site in Persimmon Gap.
A thunderstorm produced a wind gust of 76 mph at the Castolon Mesonet site.
A thunderstorm produced a 68 mph wind gust at the Castolon Mesonet site.
A thunderstorm produced a 58 mph wind gust at the Castolon Mesonet site.
A thunderstorm produced a 58 mph wind gust near Castolon.

Wind-driven hail damage was reported at Big Bend Regional Medical Center with broken windows. Hail size ranged from penny to half dollar size. Wind speed is estimated to have been between 70 to 80 mph. Property damage is an estimation.
Ping pong to golf ball-sized hail was observed in Alpine.
THis report was received from mPING.
CoCoRaHs observer reports the largest hail of quarter size.
Accumulating quarter-size hail was reported on the west side of Marathon.
Multiple power poles were found snapped along a nearly one-mile span on US Highway 67 near Hovey Rd. Time is estimated from radar. Maximum wind speed and property damage cost are estimations.
This wind gust was likely caused by an outflow boundary ahead of severe thunderstorms to the north.
Received a phone call of quarter size hail 8 miles south of Alpine along State Highway 118. Time is estimated from radar.
The RAWS Station (RGET2) Big Bend Rio Grande Village recorded a maximum wind gust of 59 MPH near a thunderstorm. Time is an approximation.
A report was received from the public of golf ball-size hail in the Chisos Basin.
A storm chaser reported half dollar-size hail on US 90 west of Marathon. The time of occurrence was estimated by radar.
An MPING report of dime-size hail was received from the public.
The Mesonet station UR285 4.4 E Marathon measured at 61 mph wind gust. The total time of occurrence is estimated.
The West Texas Mesonet station at Persimmon Gap recorded numerous severe wind gusts. The strongest gust was 75 mph.
The West Texas Mesonet station at Persimmon Gap measured a 58 mph wind gust.
The West Texas Mesonet station at Marathon measured a 59 mph wind gust.
The West Texas Mesonet station 123 1NW Castolon BBNP measured a 64 mph thunderstorm wind gust.
The West Texas Mesonet station 166 Marathon 21N measured two 58 mph wind gusts.
